versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support SOME/IP Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall support SOME/IP as a standardized serialization and RPC protocol for inter-ECU communication Rationale: SOME/IP is a serialization and RPC protocol designed for Ethernet. As Ethernet is used mainly for the transmission of large data, a specialized protocol for large data provides advantages Use Case: Inter-ECU Sender/Receiver communication.
